blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Business leaders have urged the government to ensure policy consistency and address infrastructure bottlenecks to make the Luzon Economic Corridor (LEC) a success, warning that the Philippines could miss another major investment opportunity without a coordinated national effort. Calling the initiative a “once-in-a-generation opportunity,” industry leaders said the corridor could help the Philippines attract global investors, strengthen its position in international supply chains and move into higher-value industries, including semiconductors and other advanced manufacturing sectors. But they cautioned that investors would need a predictable regulatory environment, lower electricity costs, reliable water supply and a stronger government information campaign […]...
